title: Warlock: Soul Link taken early via Talented does nothing below level 30 (fixed in Oct 15 build)
claim: Soul Link learned before level 30 through the Talented Legacy perk costs mana but applies no buff below 30; designer Aidan Moon closed GitHub #302 on Oct 13 as fixed in the next build (Oct 15).
detail: Reproduced at 25, 27 and 29 (GitHub #302, EU forums). Until the Oct 15 build is live, don't spend early points on Soul Link below 30; recheck after the build.

title: Hunter: Improved Mend Pet 2/2 raises Mend Pet mana cost (fixed in Oct 15 build)
claim: With Improved Mend Pet 2/2, Mend Pet rank 3 costs 186 mana instead of 155 (+20%) rather than 124 (-20%); designer Aidan Moon marked GitHub #316 fixed in the next build (Oct 15).
detail: Skip the talent until the Oct 15 build is live, then recheck the cost.

title: Oct 15 build: designer-confirmed class fixes that affect leveling
claim: Aidan Moon closed these as fixed in the Oct 15 (Thursday) build: Siphon Life ticks can crit (#303), Twin Disciplines boosts Mind Flay (#322) and Shadow Word: Death (#328), Improved Berserker Rage breaks roots (#305), Malediction raises Hellfire damage to enemies, not only self-damage (#311), Frost Channeling no longer raises threat (#324), Faerie Fire stacking exploit removed (#308).
detail: Also fixed: Mind Vision no longer stops enemy drinking (#321), Legacy Bountiful Harvest and Luremaster bonuses (#309, #310), talent tooltips show ranks again (#217). Not a bug (stays as is): Hunter Predator's Edge's +30% crit damage does not apply to white melee (#304; only Raptor Strike, Strider Kick, Mongoose Bite, Wing Clip); Tremor Totem stays 30 yd because baseline Totemic Mastery only sets ally-buff totems to 30 yd (#301). Shadow Priest and Warlock leveling damage goes up slightly with this build.

title: Warlock: Succubus melee crits ~0.7% instead of the 4.6% tooltip (bug report)
claim: At level 30 against level-30 targets, a Succubus landed 12 melee crits in 1,718 swings (0.70%) although the pet sheet showed 4.58% melee crit; Lash of Pain crit 6.3% (13/205). Raising the warlock's staff skill to 150 did not change the pet's crit.
detail: Three combat logs attached to GitHub #331 (labelled CRITICAL, Pending Approval); a second user confirmed. A hunter's test in RFC against lower-level mobs showed normal crit, so the problem may be specific to warlock pets vs equal-level targets. Pet melee DPS while leveling is lower than the tooltip implies until fixed. No designer reply yet.

title: World Refresh (layer switch) can drop you into a farmed-out layer mid-quest
claim: The beta's World Refresh moves players to another layer every few minutes (one player reports every 3-5 min) and whenever they invite, join or leave a group; a player reports landing in a layer with three times the players and the quest mobs already killed.
detail: Forum thread of Oct 13 (no staff reply). Icy Veins reported in September that a group invite forces a layer change for the whole group even when both are already in the same layer. For the coach: group up before reaching a kill/collect area, not at it, and expect a refresh to cost a respawn cycle. Blizzard has not said whether launch layering works the same way.

title: Ding!: free open-source Forever 1-60 leveling guide addon (v1.3, own data)
claim: Ding! v1.3.0 (repo moved to moust4ki/DingGuideWoWForever) ships 1-60 routes for both factions and every start with its own game data built from QuestieDB (QuestieDB no longer needed); its new default route takes quests up to 2 levels above you and mobs up to 1 above.
detail: 30-60 still untested in game. Adds a 'Ding! - Items' guide for the Cozy Sleeping Bag, fastest-travel arrow (flights, boats, tram, hearth), options for dungeon/elite quests and death skips, and text import/export of guides. Data source for route comparison (Ding/Guides/*).

title: Leveldon: per-race/class fastest 1-30 route addon with drop-rate-based kill counts
claim: Leveldon 0.2.2 (WoW-Forever-Addons/leveldon) plans a separate route for each race and class for levels 1-30 (30-60 untested preview) and counts kills per quest item from Wowhead drop rates.
detail: Requires the Questdon quest-helper addon (same org). Packs (murlocs, Defias) are scheduled only once above their top level; class quests are slotted as soon as their level is reached; vendor-bought quest items are bought on the way. Routes.lua per race (~2 MB each) is a candidate data source for route comparison.
